import re
import pytest
from target import url_basename

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url,expected",
    [
        # Empty input
        ("", u""),
        # Only scheme and domain, no path
        ("http://example.com", u""),
        ("https://example.com", u""),
        ("//example.com", u""),
        # Domain with trailing slash
        ("http://example.com/", u""),
        ("https://example.com/", u""),
        ("//example.com/", u""),
        # Single path segment
        ("http://example.com/foo", u"foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo", u"foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo", u"foo"),
        # Single path segment with trailing slash
        ("http://example.com/foo/", u"foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo/", u"foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo/", u"foo"),
        # Single path segment with query
        ("http://example.com/foo?bar=baz", u"foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo?bar=baz", u"foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo?bar=baz", u"foo"),
        # Single path segment with fragment
        ("http://example.com/foo#section", u"foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo#section", u"foo"),
        ("//example.com/foo#section", u"foo"),
        # Two path segments
        ("http://example.com/a/b", u"b"),
        ("https://example.com/a/b", u"b"),
        ("//example.com/a/b", u"b"),
        # Two path segments with trailing slash
        ("http://example.com/a/b/", u"b"),
        # Two path segments with query
        ("http://example.com/a/b?x=1", u"b"),
        # Two path segments with fragment
        ("http://example.com/a/b#frag", u"b"),
        # Three path segments – old behavior returns the last segment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", u"c"),
        ("https://example.com/a/b/c", u"c"),
        ("//example.com/a/b/c", u"c"),
        # Three path segments with trailing slash
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c/", u"c"),
        # Three path segments with query
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c?x=1", u"c"),
        # Three path segments with fragment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c#frag", u"c"),
        # Path containing characters that could be confused with delimiters
        ("http://example.com/a?b/c", u"a?b"),
        ("http://example.com/a#b/c", u"a#b"),
        # Non‑URL strings should return empty
        ("justastring", u""),
        ("ftp://example.com/file", u""),
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_behaviour(url, expected):
    """Ensure url_basename matches the original specification."""
    assert url_basename(url) == expected


def test_regex_edge_cases():
    """Additional checks for edge‑case handling."""
    # Very long path – should still return the last segment
    long_path = "http://example.com/" + "/".join([f"seg{i}" for i in range(100)]) + "/last"
    assert url_basename(long_path) == "last"

    # Path segment of zero length (double slash) – should be ignored and return next segment
    assert url_basename("http://example.com//foo") == "foo"

    # URL with only scheme and double slash but no domain – should return empty
    assert url_basename("http:////") == u""

    # URL with unusual but valid characters in the basename
    assert url_basename("http://example.com/!$&'()*+,;=:@") == "!$&'()*+,;=:@"
